label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Memorial Tournament Field
items.text: Scottie Scheffler returns to defend his title at the 2026 Memorial Tournament June 4–7, joined by Rory McIlroy and others, while Viktor Hovland withdrew before the entry deadline.

items.headline: Mickelson's LIV Absence
items.text: Phil Mickelson remains on an extended LIV Golf break for a family emergency, leaving Scott Vincent to represent HyFlyers GC with the team improving from last place.

items.headline: Viktor Hovland Withdrawal
items.text: After missing the cut at the 2026 PGA Championship, Viktor Hovland has withdrawn from his next event, marking his first withdrawal of the year due to ongoing setbacks.
